title: The Protocol of Vienna
author: Jude Okonkwo
blurb: Wren Thornbury, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
